target.definition: Number of foreign visitor arrivals to Japan in August 2026, as first reported in JNTO's monthly estimate.

inputs.name: japan_annual_visitors_2025
inputs.description: Total foreign visitor arrivals to Japan in calendar year 2025, as reported by JNTO.

provenance.rationale: Extrapolates recent strong growth from 25M in 2023 and 36.9M in 2024, with 2025 likely around 40M.

inputs.name: august_share_of_annual
inputs.description: Fraction of annual foreign visitor arrivals that occur in August.

provenance.rationale: August is peak summer holiday season; historical monthly shares typically range 8-10%.

inputs.name: annual_growth_factor_2025_to_2026
inputs.description: Year-over-year growth factor for foreign visitor arrivals from 2025 to 2026.

provenance.rationale: Continued recovery and growth expected, but with uncertainty due to economic and geopolitical factors.

inputs.name: august_2025_visitors
inputs.description: Foreign visitor arrivals to Japan in August 2025, as reported by JNTO.

provenance.rationale: Based on 2024 August estimate of ~3.2M and assumed growth; actual 2025 data not yet published.

inputs.name: august_growth_factor_2025_to_2026
inputs.description: Year-over-year growth factor for foreign visitor arrivals in August from 2025 to 2026.

provenance.rationale: Similar to annual growth, but August-specific factors may cause slight variation.

inputs.name: japan_annual_visitors_2024
inputs.description: Total foreign visitor arrivals to Japan in calendar year 2024, as reported by JNTO.

provenance.quote: 2024年暦年の訪日外客数は3,687万人

inputs.name: august_2024_visitors
inputs.description: Foreign visitor arrivals to Japan in August 2024, as reported by JNTO.

provenance.rationale: Approximate figure from JNTO monthly estimates; August 2024 was a peak month.

inputs.name: annual_growth_factor_2024_to_2025
inputs.description: Year-over-year growth factor for foreign visitor arrivals from 2024 to 2025.

provenance.rationale: Growth expected to continue but at a moderating pace compared to 2024.

inputs.name: august_growth_factor_2024_to_2025
inputs.description: Year-over-year growth factor for foreign visitor arrivals in August from 2024 to 2025.

provenance.rationale: August-specific growth may differ slightly from annual trend.

paths.description: Estimate annual 2026 visitors from 2025 total and growth, then allocate to August using seasonal share.
Start from August 2025 actual and apply year-over-year growth factor for August.
Use 2024 annual and August figures, apply two years of growth factors to project August 2026.
